name: Ashok Bhargab

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Ashok Bhargava is a Vancouver-based poet and photographer who writes in English and Hindi. His collections include Skipping Stones, Mirror of Dreams, A Kernel of Truth and Lost in the Morning Calm. His author website brings his poetry and photography together with records of literary community activity.

Kabita Live’s Maya - Illusion uses very short stanzas to unsettle the certainty of knowing. The speaker moves from I and you to we and they, repeatedly handing knowledge from one side to the other. Its final turn towards illusion makes the spare pattern into a meditation on perception.
